meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把口播或访谈视频加上随字幕同步的图形卡片,原片画面保持不动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有口播或访谈素材,想加同步图形卡但不想动原画面。
copy.tagline_en: Add transcript-synced graphic cards to your talking-head video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have talking-head footage and want graphic cards fast

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会给已有的口播、访谈或播客视频叠加按时间同步的图形卡片(标题、下三分之一、数据标注、引用、侧栏、画中画等),视频本身原样播放,最后渲染成 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 的 MP4。
howto.when: 当你提到「graphic overlays」「on-screen graphics」等关键词,或要求给视频加图形包装时触发;它只做图形卡片,不做普通字幕(那属于 embedded-captions),意图不清时先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给这条口播视频加上图形卡片包装
say.note: 先转录,再逐张设计卡片

say.text: 把这段访谈做成 9:16 竖版,加下三分之一和数据标注
say.note: 卡片数量按视频时长和信息密度推

say.text: 这段播客不要字幕,只要数据标注和引用卡片
say.note: 字幕需求会被转到 embedded-captions

howto.what_en: Adds timed, designed graphic cards — titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, PiP — over an existing talking-head, interview, or podcast clip. The video plays untouched; output renders to 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say “graphic overlays”, “on-screen graphics”, or ask to package/dress up a video. Plain subtitles go to embedded-captions; unclear intent routes through /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Package this talking-head clip with graphic overlay cards
say_en.note: Transcribes first, then designs each card

say_en.text: Make this interview 9:16 with lower-thirds and data callouts
say_en.note: Card count follows length and density

say_en.text: No captions for this podcast — add data callouts and quote cards
